rankedLeadSummary: 1. Sleep D & Mosam Howieson — Inertia: 135 BPM; label explicitly frames Inertia and Mirror Pool as respite with a psychedelic/emotive strain after peak-time pressure
2. MMali — Fall of Man: current Sep 3; track-specific patient deep-techno excursion with cavernous atmosphere, layered synthesis and spatial depth
3. AgainstMe — Enstikto: Aug 14 ARA release framed as first-class dancefloor hypnosis with class and funk knowledge
4. OK EG — Gunma Rain: overlooked Butter Sessions compilation cut described as zoned psychoactive techno; 130 BPM metadata
